# PointInPolygon

<!-- gen:begin summary -->
<!-- Generated by `npm run generate:op-docs` from noodles-validate/registry.json. The title and the text between gen:begin and gen:end markers are replaced on every run; write anywhere else. -->

Filter points that fall within a polygon boundary.
<!-- gen:end summary -->

## Syntax

<!-- gen:begin syntax -->
```json
{
  "id": "/point-in-polygon",
  "type": "PointInPolygonOp",
  "position": { "x": 0, "y": 0 },
  "data": { "inputs": {} }
}
```

Expressions and code read its fields as `op('/point-in-polygon').par.points` (an input) and `op('/point-in-polygon').out.inside` (an output). Edges name the same fields as handles: `par.points`, `out.inside`.
<!-- gen:end syntax -->

## Inputs

<!-- gen:begin inputs -->
| Name | Type | Default |
|------|------|---------|
| `points` | `GeoJsonField` | `{"type":"FeatureCollection","features":[]}` |
| `polygon` | `GeoJsonField` | `{"type":"FeatureCollection","features":[]}` |
| `invert` | `BooleanField` | `false` |
<!-- gen:end inputs -->

## Outputs

<!-- gen:begin outputs -->
| Name | Type |
|------|------|

<!-- gen:end outputs -->
